messages.content: 誰是爵士樂中最好的歌手？

function.name: search_music_instrument_players
function.description: Searches for top music instrument players in a specified music genre. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument.description: The type of musical instrument, e.g. trumpet

top.description: Number of top players to return. Default is 5.

message.content:
以下列出一些被廣泛認為在爵士樂界具有極高聲譽與影響力的歌手（按字母順序排列，並非排名）：

| 歌手 | 代表作品 / 標誌性風格 |
|------|---------------------|
| **Billie Holiday** | “Strange Fruit”, “God Bless the Child” |
| **Ella Fitzgerald** | “Dream a Little Dream of Me”, “Summertime” |
| **Sarah Vaughan** | “Misty”, “Lullaby of Birdland” |
| **Nina Simone** | “Feeling Good”, “I Put a Spell on You” |
| **Cassandra Wilson** | “The First Time I Saw Your Face”, “Blue Skies” |
| **Diana Krall** | “The Look of Love”, “All of Me” |
| **Norah Jones** | “Come Away With Me”, “Don't Know Why” |
| **John Coltrane (作曲/演奏)** | 雖以小號/薩克斯風聞名，但其歌曲《My Favorite Things》亦常被翻唱成爵士版 |
| **Louis Armstrong** | “What a Wonderful World”, “Stardust” |
| **Charles Mingus (作曲/低音提琴)** | 同樣以創作聞名，其作品如《Goodbye Pork Pie Hat》常被歌手翻唱 |

> **備註**：如果你想了解某位歌手的生平、主要專輯或演出歷史，我可以再提供更詳細的資訊。
message.reasoning: The user asks "誰是爵士樂中最好的歌手？" which means "Who is the best jazz singer?" They want a list of top singers. We can use the function search_music_instrument_players? That function searches for top instrument players, not singers. There's no function for singers. So we need to answer manually. Provide a list of top jazz singers. Use knowledge up to 2024. Provide maybe 10 names. Also ask if they want more info.
